title: Senator Gary Peters (D-MI) Delivers the Weekly Democratic Address
description: “As cases of coronavirus are skyrocketing, I, along with my Senate Democratic colleagues, are working to protect the health and safety of people across our nation,” said Senator Peters (D-MI). “The sweeping legislation we’ve passed is an important step as we navigate this crisis, but it’s not the last action we’ll need to take. We don’t know how long this pandemic will last, but you can count us to be there every step of the way.”
